## Claim and commit

Which exact statement or artifact did you check?

## Command and environment

Python/package versions, operating system, and reproduction command:

## Outcome and evidence

Include a minimal example or bounded log excerpt. Distinguish a failed computation from a gap in the mathematical argument.

## Prior work, if applicable

Link the source and identify the matching theorem or proof.

## Scope

What does this check establish, and what did you not check? Please do not include private correspondence or credentials.
